_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Paladin tracks (class is spelled Paladin in this project; the data's item rows say 'Paladin'). gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped. Forever renames vs Cata: Divine Protection(defensive)->Templar's Bulwark, Divine Wrath->Avenging Wrath, Hammer of Justice->Voice of Truth, Redemption->Redemption, Avenging Shield proc present. No Steed spells and no Crusader Aura exist in this build's data (the classic Paladin has Righteous Fury as its tank stance). Ancestral Guidance (also Shaman), Rebuke (also Rogue) and Divine Protection (also Priest) resolve to Paladin rows via the generator's family-scoped rank resolution; the Templar's Bulwark cooldown is the paladin defensive CD side, the Divine Protection buff-window is tracked here.
